learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to draw happy faces and stick figures of our friends, family, and neighborhood helpers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A face is a big circle or oval! Inside, we can add two small circles for eyes, a little line for a nose, and a big curve for a happy smile.
Stick figures are a super fun way to draw people running, jumping, or dancing. Just use simple straight lines for arms and legs!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Family Portrait
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a picture of your family holding hands. Make sure to give everyone a big, bright smile and colorful clothes!

quick_recap: ⭐ Faces have different expressions like happy, sad, or surprised.
⭐ Stick figures help us show people moving and playing.
⭐ We can draw the special people in our lives to show we love them!
